cards.back:
An official book that shows who you are when you travel to other countries.
Bahasa Indonesia: paspor
Example: Dad kept our passports safe in his bag at the airport.
cards.say: passport. Dad kept our passports safe in his bag at the airport.

cards.back:
The bags and cases you take with you on a journey.
Bahasa Indonesia: bagasi
Example: We put all our luggage on the trolley before checking in.
cards.say: luggage. We put all our luggage on the trolley before checking in.

cards.back:
The time or act of leaving a place.
Bahasa Indonesia: keberangkatan
Example: The departure board showed that our flight would leave at noon.
cards.say: departure. The departure board showed that our flight would leave at noon.

cards.back:
The time or act of reaching a place.
Bahasa Indonesia: kedatangan
Example: Our arrival at the hotel was delayed by heavy traffic.
cards.say: arrival. Our arrival at the hotel was delayed by heavy traffic.

cards.back:
A time when something happens later than planned.
Bahasa Indonesia: penundaan
Example: A long delay at the station made us miss the first show.
cards.say: delay. A long delay at the station made us miss the first show.

cards.back:
A plan that lists the places you will visit on a trip.
Bahasa Indonesia: rencana perjalanan
Example: Our itinerary for Bali includes a temple visit on the second day.
cards.say: itinerary. Our itinerary for Bali includes a temple visit on the second day.

cards.back:
The place at an airport where officers check what you bring into a country.
Bahasa Indonesia: bea cukai
Example: We waited in a long queue at customs after landing.
cards.say: customs. We waited in a long queue at customs after landing.

cards.back:
A small thing you buy to remember a place you visited.
Bahasa Indonesia: oleh-oleh
Example: I bought a wooden mask as a souvenir of our holiday.
cards.say: souvenir. I bought a wooden mask as a souvenir of our holiday.

cards.back:
The place where someone or something is going.
Bahasa Indonesia: tujuan
Example: Yogyakarta is the final destination of this train.
cards.say: destination. Yogyakarta is the final destination of this train.

cards.back:
A trip from one place to another, usually a long one.
Bahasa Indonesia: perjalanan
Example: The journey by boat to the island took three hours.
cards.say: journey. The journey by boat to the island took three hours.

cards.back:
A person who visits a place for fun and to see the sights.
Bahasa Indonesia: wisatawan
Example: Many tourists take photographs of the old fort every morning.
cards.say: tourist. Many tourists take photographs of the old fort every morning.

cards.back:
A short trip made for pleasure, often with a group.
Bahasa Indonesia: tamasya
Example: Our class went on an excursion to the botanical gardens.
cards.say: excursion. Our class went on an excursion to the botanical gardens.

cards.back:
A place where you can stay, such as a hotel.
Bahasa Indonesia: akomodasi
Example: The travel agent found cheap accommodation near the beach.
cards.say: accommodation. The travel agent found cheap accommodation near the beach.

cards.back:
An arrangement to keep a seat, room or table for you.
Bahasa Indonesia: reservasi
Example: Mum made a reservation for four people at the seaside cafe.
cards.say: reservation. Mum made a reservation for four people at the seaside cafe.

cards.back:
The type of money used in a country.
Bahasa Indonesia: mata uang
Example: The currency in Japan is the yen, not the dollar.
cards.say: currency. The currency in Japan is the yen, not the dollar.

cards.back:
Visiting famous places to look at them.
Bahasa Indonesia: berwisata melihat-lihat
Example: We spent the whole afternoon sightseeing in the old city.
cards.say: sightseeing. We spent the whole afternoon sightseeing in the old city.

cards.back:
A long journey, especially by sea or in space.
Bahasa Indonesia: pelayaran
Example: The explorers began their voyage across the ocean at dawn.
cards.say: voyage. The explorers began their voyage across the ocean at dawn.

cards.back:
A place where many people go for a holiday.
Bahasa Indonesia: tempat peristirahatan
Example: The family stayed at a resort with three swimming pools.
cards.say: resort. The family stayed at a resort with three swimming pools.

cards.back:
A book that gives information to help visitors in a place.
Bahasa Indonesia: buku panduan wisata
Example: The guidebook told us which beaches were safe for swimming.
cards.say: guidebook. The guidebook told us which beaches were safe for swimming.

cards.back:
To get on a ship or plane, or to start a journey.
Bahasa Indonesia: naik (kapal atau pesawat)
Example: Passengers will embark at gate five in ten minutes.
cards.say: embark. Passengers will embark at gate five in ten minutes.

cards.back:
The natural views of a place, such as hills and rivers.
Bahasa Indonesia: pemandangan
Example: The scenery from the train window was beautiful and green.
cards.say: scenery. The scenery from the train window was beautiful and green.

cards.back:
In or to another country across the sea.
Bahasa Indonesia: luar negeri
Example: My cousin is studying overseas and returns home in July.
cards.say: overseas. My cousin is studying overseas and returns home in July.
